blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines–Rianne Malixi and Justin delos Santos churned out contrasting final rounds in winding up as the best individual performers for Team Philippines in the Asian Games that pulled the curtains down on its dramatic golf tournament that had China claiming team glory on Saturday. Malixi, the all-American as a rookie with Duke University, fired a 67 and finished in a tie for fifth spot as she cemented her status as the best women’s talent back home despite playing against a field made up mostly of pros and six other members of the world’s top 50 amateurs.
